request.style: English, female vocal, warm and soulful, upright bass, brushed snare, trumpet, piano, Rhodes electric piano, intimate and reflective, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
How can they call on the one unknown
How can they trust a face not seen
The bridge of belief must be drawn
Before the voice is ever heard

[Pre-Chorus]
How can they believe without a sound
Without a preacher standing near
How can they hear if no one speaks
Unless the messenger is sent

[Chorus]
So faith comes from hearing clearly now
And hearing comes through the word of Christ
The voice has gone out to the earth
The words to the ends of the world

[Verse]
How beautiful the feet that run
Carrying the good news to the gate
Not all have obeyed the call
But the message rings with holy weight

[Pre-Chorus]
How can they believe without a sound
Without a preacher standing near
How can they hear if no one speaks
Unless the messenger is sent

[Chorus]
So faith comes from hearing clearly now
And hearing comes through the word of Christ
The voice has gone out to the earth
The words to the ends of the world

[Bridge]
I will make you jealous by strangers
By a nation without understanding
I was found by those not looking
I revealed myself to the blind

[Chorus]
So faith comes from hearing clearly now
And hearing comes through the word of Christ
The voice has gone out to the earth
The words to the ends of the world

[Outro]
Faith comes from hearing
Hearing through the word
